brief.headline: Jio Platforms files IPO papers, issue opens October 21
brief.detail: Jio Platforms filed its IPO papers for a fresh issue of up to 27 crore shares, opening October 21, and seeks a $108 billion valuation.

brief.detail: Inflation rose 3.7% annually in September, above the 3.6% consensus forecast, as gas prices skyrocketed.

brief.detail: ASML's profit smashed expectations, and some customers are expressing interest in placing orders in 2029 and 2030, giving a longer-term demand view.
